title: Colors
description: colors: the palette (name → hex). roles: what each colour does (role → colour name). schemes: role overrides for a context, used with data-scheme="name". Any role a scheme leaves out keeps its value from roles. The playground is the parent demo and deliberately has no brand of its own: this is a neutral greyscale close to the browser's own defaults. A site replaces these values; the role names stay.
